description: Presidential Secretariat - A Proclamation by the President Railway Services to be an Essential Public Service
categorisation: This gazette content contains an order by the President declaring certain public services as essential under the Essential Public Services Act, No. 61 of 1979. It involves the exercise of statutory powers to create legal obligations and regulatory frameworks, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel or structural changes. The content focuses on establishing legal status and regulatory requirements for essential services rather than naming individuals or describing government organizational changes.
